question_text: A patient presents to the clinic with symptoms of dizziness on standing up. He says it started soon after he was diagnosed with hypertension and started taking treatment for it.             ### Question

Which of the following should be the drug of choice for this patient?

opd. Amlodipine
ope. Propanolol
